Hi Liam —

Great to meet earlier. Quick recap and a couple of proposed next steps so we can lock a technical walkthrough: 

Recap (from today's discovery)
- Primary goal: reduce inference cost for real-time triage while keeping median latency under 250ms.
- Key constraints: HIPAA-adjacent data, VPC requirement for production, preference for reserved capacity.
- Success metrics: 50% unit-cost reduction vs current baseline and <1% quality regression on triage prompts.

Proposed next step: 60–75 minute technical walkthrough (solutions + infra) where we:
1) Map your current topology (ingest, preprocessing, model endpoints)
2) Discuss model variants, quantization, and autoscaling policies
3) Walkthrough a sample inference trace and latency/cost tradeoffs

Suggested slots (PT):
- Tue Nov 10: 10:00–11:15am PT
- Wed Nov 11: 2:00–3:15pm PT

Can you confirm which slot works and who from your side will attend? If useful, I can include one of our infra engineers (Monica) and the AE (Marissa) to cover SSO/KMS and commercial questions.

I've attached a one-pager and a draft agenda to help prep.

Thanks,
